questions.prompt: If a substance is made up just one type of atom it is referred to as:
A compound is best described as:
options: a substance made of only one type of atoms
a substance made of elements which are chemically combined
a substance made of metals and non-metals
questions.explanation: C. a substance made of elements which are chemically combined. [1]

questions.prompt: Which of the following shows the formula of an element?
Which type of particles is not found in the nucleus of an atom?
Which of the following is not true about protons?
options: They have a mass of 1/12 of the mass of a carbon atom.
They have a relative mass of 1
They always equal the number of neutrons.
questions.explanation: D. They always equal the number of neutrons.. [1]

questions.prompt: For any isotope, the number of protons + the number of neutrons is equal to:
An atom has 11 protons, 12 neutrons and 10 electrons it is:
In a neutral atom, the number of electrons is always:
options: equal to the number of protons
equal to the number of neutrons
questions.explanation: A. equal to the number of protons. [1]
